title: ACE music (ACE-Step)
description: Creates intended backing music or a full song. Lyrics are optional: without them it makes instrumental music.

parameters.name: music_direction
parameters.label: Music direction
parameters.doc: Describe the intended backing music, arrangement and vocal treatment. Unlike AI voice, this block is allowed to make accompaniment.
parameters.placeholder: for example: dreamy synth pop, 90 BPM, female vocal

parameters.name: steps
parameters.doc: Number of diffusion steps. Empty takes what the chosen model wants (turbo 8, sft and base 50).

parameters.name: adapter
parameters.label: Adapter (LoRA)
parameters.doc: The name of an adapter (LoRA) the local ACE server lists (it must be started with --adapters). Empty: no adapter. It changes the sound of the result.

parameters.name: adapter_scale
parameters.label: Adapter strength
parameters.doc: How strongly the adapter works; empty is 1.

parameters.name: voice_strength
parameters.label: Reference cover strength
parameters.doc: With audio linked to the reference input: besides taking its voice, make the result a cover of it at this strength (0 hardly, 1 as close as possible; it follows the melody of the reference too). Empty: only the voice.

parameters.name: guidance
parameters.label: CFG (guidance scale)
parameters.doc: Classifier-free guidance scale sent to ACE-Step and recorded with the take. The Studio shows the resolved default: 7 for Base/SFT, 1 for Turbo. Changing CFG can change the generated music.

parameters.name: shift
parameters.label: Schedule shift
parameters.doc: Diffusion timestep schedule: SFT defaults to 1, Base/Turbo to 3. Stored in the render recipe; keep fixed when comparing seeds.

parameters.name: solver
parameters.label: Diffusion solver
parameters.doc: Explicit diffusion solver, sent to ACE and stored with the take. Euler is the default.

parameters.name: lm_temperature
parameters.label: LM temperature
parameters.doc: Explicit language-model sampling input. Stored with the generated audio-code plan; keep fixed when comparing seeds.

parameters.name: lm_cfg_scale
parameters.label: LM CFG
parameters.doc: Explicit language-model sampling input. Stored with the generated audio-code plan; keep fixed when comparing seeds.

parameters.name: lm_top_p
parameters.label: LM top-p
parameters.doc: Explicit language-model sampling input. Stored with the generated audio-code plan; keep fixed when comparing seeds.

parameters.name: lm_top_k
parameters.label: LM top-k
parameters.doc: Explicit language-model sampling input. Stored with the generated audio-code plan; keep fixed when comparing seeds.

parameters.name: lm_negative_prompt
parameters.label: LM negative prompt
parameters.doc: Explicit negative caption for language-model CFG; empty means the caption-less unconditional prompt.

parameters.name: lm_seed
parameters.doc: The seed for the language model; derived from the song seed when not set explicitly.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.doc: The diffusion seed; derived from the song seed when not set explicitly.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).

parameters.name: engine
parameters.label: Engine
parameters.doc: Where and with which model this block is rendered, overriding the project: a place (local, faer or faer-else-local), optionally a colon and a model family (default, turbo, sft, base, xl-turbo, xl-sft, xl-base) or a .gguf file name, for example faer:xl-sft. Empty: the project routes and the settings of the song decide. Asking for faer without a Faer connection stops the build with an error; it never falls back to local.
